crossRefs.note: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: It was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.
translations.bsb: And so it has been from that day forward. David established this statute and ordinance for Israel to this very day.
translations.kjv: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
translations.asv: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
